assertions.assertion: Recommends setting options.KeyManagement.Enabled = false in test configuration
assertions.rationale: Explicitly recommends `options.KeyManagement.Enabled = false` to stop disk writes.

assertions.assertion: Recommends AddDeveloperSigningCredential(persistKey: false) to avoid disk writes
assertions.rationale: Recommends `.AddDeveloperSigningCredential(persistKey: false)` and notes the default overload persists to disk.

assertions.assertion: Warns against hard-coding localhost ports — use factory.CreateClient() BaseAddress instead
assertions.rationale: Section 2 warns against hard-coded localhost:5001 and shows using `factory.CreateClient()` BaseAddress.

assertions.assertion: Mentions the risk of sharing HttpClient or ClaimsProvider state across parallel tests
assertions.rationale: Section 3 covers shared HttpClient/ClaimsProvider/static Config state bleeding across parallel xUnit tests and fixes.
